title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Account Agreement — Closing a Payout Account
content:
## Section A — Closing terms in force

A.1 Negative balance. Where the payout plan blocks closure while the balance is negative, a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account with a negative balance cannot be closed until the balance is recovered. Every current plan, from Weekly Direct Deposit to Everyday Pay Card Diamond, carries its own setting on this point, read from the plan's terms.

A.2 Evidence. Whether the balance is negative is read from the unpaid earnings balance shown on the same payout account record at the time of closing, not from the shopper's estimate of it.

A.3 Frozen accounts. A frozen payout account is closed only by the review team, with the closing reason "freeze review closure".

### Points of judgement under A.1 and A.3 (plan that blocks closure while negative)

| Account status | Balance on the record | Closing under these terms |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 0.00 or above | Not blocked by A.1 |
| Active | Below 0.00 (for example a hypothetical minus 4.20) | Cannot be closed until the balance is recovered |
| Frozen | Any | Closed only by the review team |

## Section B — Closing terms no longer in force

B.1 The former clause under which only the shopper could close an active payout account, the agent registering the request and the shopper confirming it, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

B.2 The former clause under which, on closure, the remaining balance was paid by the plan's closing disbursement method within the plan's final disbursement time in business days, and unpaid cashback lapsed on plans forfeiting unpaid cashback at closing, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

The plan's closing disbursement method (a final bank deposit or a final card load), its final disbursement time and its forfeiture setting remain figures of each plan; only the handling clauses in Section B are withdrawn.

superseded_clauses: Only the shopper can close an active payout account; the agent registers the request and the shopper confirms it.
On closure the remaining balance is paid by closure_disbursement within final_disbursement_business_days, and unpaid cashback lapses where cashback_forfeit_on_close is true.
